title: Bitcoin dips to $72K on hot US PPI inflation hours before Fed FOMC meeting
summary: Bitcoin price action fell to week-to-date lows with Bitcoin caught between high US inflation and nerves over Fed policy hints at the day's FOMC meeting.

title: 74% of institutions expect crypto prices to rise in 12 months: Survey
summary: A Coinbase-EY study reveals institutional investors plan to boost crypto allocations in 2026, favoring regulated products as stablecoins and tokenization gain traction.

title: Crypto firms’ open letter urges top US colleges to teach DeFi
summary: Crypto firms argue that DeFi should be taught at top schools so that students can eventually take on a rapid rise in non-technical crypto jobs on Wall Street.

title: Crypto cards aren't the future, but onchain credit is
summary: Crypto cards force asset sales and tax hits. Onchain credit enables yield-bearing collateral power spending without liquidation, making cards obsolete interfaces.

title: RedotPay defends team reshuffle amid funding talks and IPO plans
summary: RedotPay says it restructured teams for efficiency after a Bloomberg report flagged executive turnover, China sensitivities and new funding talks.

title: Connecticut suspends Bitcoin Depot as 2026 revenue outlook worsens
summary: Connecticut halts Bitcoin Depot’s operations, with the company expecting lower revenue in 2026 amid mounting regulatory pressure and a steep decline in its stock price.

title: UK lawmakers seek moratorium on crypto donations to political parties
summary: A UK parliamentary committee urged an immediate moratorium on crypto political donations until stronger safeguards are in place.

title: Tally winds down, citing lack of viable market for DAO tooling
summary: Tally said its platform served more than one million users, supporting governance across hundreds of organizations and processing over $1 billion in payments.

title: Bitcoin stalls at $76K: Key BTC price levels to watch ahead of FOMC
summary: Bitcoin price traded at $74,000 as investors braced for Jerome Powell’s post-FOMC speech that could see volatile swings toward key BTC price levels.

title: Ethereum aims to cut bridge times by 98% to 13 seconds with new rule
summary: Ethereum’s FCR aims to reduce bridge times by up to 98%, bringing L1-to-L2 and exchange deposits down to 13 seconds without a hard fork.
